== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Danz Borin (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. Compared with [[Danz Borin (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2019 disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>f23bf696d94168c70aff07c6d020c4166a9d9ded</code>.
